### Keeping the Lord's Day
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/keeping-the-lords-day
Passage: Deuteronomy 5:12-15
Points:
- Cultural observance of the Sabbath as a day of rest has significantly declined in modern society.
- Rooted in creation, the Sabbath establishes an enduring pattern to cease ordinary vocational labor one day in seven.
- Under the new covenant, Christians keep the Lord's Day on the first day of the week to celebrate Christ's resurrection.
- Deuteronomy ties the command directly to God's redemption from slavery, showing that remembering salvation requires worship.
- Believers hallow the day by setting aside regular work and gathering with God's people for corporate worship.
